comment: Recorded ownership for renamed skill links. The old 'lenovo-release' junction (personal-agent-toolkit pointer skill) is removed only when every proof holds: -AllowOldLinkMigration was passed, the recorded new skill ships in this pinned checkout, and the old entry is a junction whose target directory holds a SKILL.md with the recorded frontmatter name and the recorded body marker. A foreign junction, a plain directory or file, or an unreadable manifest leaves the old entry unchanged.
